title: Not.what I expected
text: Not.what I expected. These are some sort of terry cloth.  Not all all what was expected.  Perhaps I read the description incorrectly.  Will use in a rental cottage in lieu of returning.  Can’t comment as to softness, water resistance nor ease of cleaning as have not even opened the package yet.
